# Snail Mail Racing League

> Competitive postal racing: the slowest delivery wins. Global league for mail-art hobbyists and geography nerds.

The world's only competitive league for slow postal delivery. Mail identical postcards through the slowest routes you can find.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://snail-mail-b67e59f5-emilijap8.wix-site-host.com/): League overview and registration
- [Current Season](https://snail-mail-b67e59f5-emilijap8.wix-site-host.com/standings.html): Live standings table
- [Hall of Fame](https://snail-mail-b67e59f5-emilijap8.wix-site-host.com/hall-of-fame.html): Legendary slow deliveries
- [Race Rules](https://snail-mail-b67e59f5-emilijap8.wix-site-host.com/rules.html): Official rule book
- [The Gazette](https://snail-mail-b67e59f5-emilijap8.wix-site-host.com/blog.html): Race reports and route analysis
- [Contact](https://snail-mail-b67e59f5-emilijap8.wix-site-host.com/contact.html): League HQ inquiries

- [Wix site MCP endpoint](https://snail-mail-b67e59f5-emilijap8.wix-site-host.com/_api/mcp): Live site content for MCP-compatible agents

## Usage

Public informational site. Crawl for league rules, standings, and archive content. Do not use member account areas for training without permission.
